params.body:
## What

`php artisan stocklist:demo-screens [--photos=<dir>]` fills an **empty local database** with a small, realistic dataset for the screenshots on stocklistdealer.eu, demos and browser tests. The marketing site will show real screens of the app; those screens must not show the stock of another dealer.

- **Three dealers**: StockCars (Staatsbaan 35, Adegem; real client, agreed to appear; placeholder phone `+32 50 00 00 00`), Autohandel Zuid (Kortrijk, fictional) and the trader Van Dijk Handel (Breda, fictional). One administrator login each on `example.com`, password `demo-screens`, printed by the command.
- **StockCars**: fifteen own vehicles (real makes and models, plausible mileage, prices, first registration, fuel, transmission, colour, options, a description; 17-character chassis numbers with `DEMO` in them), thirteen on the shared stocklist, most on the website. Three bidding vehicles: open with three bids from the two other dealers, closed with a winner whose next step is "release for pickup", published today (seven-day window, original owner as a relation, per B1-1).
- **Autohandel Zuid**: five vehicles on the shared stocklist.
- Customer Jan Peeters with an offer (Golf), an order (Yaris) and a transport request (row only; the observer would call Mollie).
- **Photos**: two per vehicle plus the platform copies for stocklist vehicles, written the way `ProcessVehiclePhoto` does (original, medium, thumb, derived sizes under `media_version`/`media_set`); `--photos` takes JPEGs round-robin, without it GD draws placeholders with the model name. No remove.bg, no Blurit.
- **Reference data** only where the schema dump left the table empty: roles, languages, countries (Belgium keeps id 21), a navigation tree with `role_access`, category group, body styles, fuel types, transmissions, colours, paint types, usage categories, makes and models, option groups and options, salutations, widgets.
- **Idempotent**: keyed on e-mail and chassis number; a second run refreshes the same rows and keeps the ids. **Refuses to run in production.** Everything is written with the query builder so no observer reaches a third party.
- `VEHICLES_DISK=local` (config/filesystems.php, off by default) puts the `vehicles` disk on the machine; `VehicleImageService` then serves and resizes through the app route.
- `docs/demo-screens.md` documents the logins, what is seeded and how to run it.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/DemoScreensCommandTest.php`: counts (3 dealers, 23 vehicles, 3 biddings, 5 bids, 1 winner, 1 offer, 1 order, 1 transport, photos on every vehicle, login shape, bidding steps `bidding/bidding/release`, VIN format), idempotency, production guard. MyISAM rows the seeder adds (roles, menus, role_access, countries, languages) are removed in `tearDown`.

Run locally on a fresh schema database: `DemoScreensCommandTest|ScheduleTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|RulesDocsBuildTest|AccessWithoutSessionRightsTest|CompiledViewsTest|RouteCacheTest` OK (26 tests, 143 assertions); `SmokeTest|IntegrationSmokeTest|OutboundTest|GeenExterneCallsTest` OK (276 tests, 555 assertions).

Verified in a browser (1440 px) logged in as `demo.stockcars@example.com`: own fleet list, vehicle sheet (`own-vehicles/{id}/edit`), stocklist (18 vehicles, two sellers), "Mijn aangeboden wagens" with the three states, and the bidding offer.

## Finding

`docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-16-conceptfiche-herladen-schrijft-48500-als-48-5.md`: opening `own-vehicles/create/{id}` posts the formatted sheet values (`48.500`, `1.300`) raw to `tempupdate`, which stores them as 48.5 and 1.3. Not changed here; the edit route the list uses does not do this.

## Note on counts

The brief said twenty vehicles and three bids; the set as briefed is fifteen own + three biddings + five for Zuid = 23, and a closed bidding with a winner needs at least one bid, so the closed one carries two.
